finding.title: Order history runs one item query per order
finding.explanation: orderHistory fetches a page of orders, then awaits a separate orderItem.findMany for each one, in sequence. A full page costs 22 round trips (count, page, 20 item lookups) and none of them overlap, so latency grows with the page size. Repeat customers hit a full page on every visit.
finding.reasoningSummary: The loop awaits inside for...of, so the queries are sequential. The Order model already has an `items` relation (prisma/schema.prisma), so the items can come back with the orders in one query.
